description.pt_BR: Entre o Cristo Redentor e a Barra da Tijuca cabe toda a carreira política da família: gabinetes na Câmara Municipal e na Alerj, assessores que nunca apareceram e um condomínio de frente para o mar que entrou para o noticiário policial.
description.en: Between Christ the Redeemer and Barra da Tijuca lies the family's whole political career: offices at city hall and in the state assembly, staffers who never showed up, and a beachfront condo that made the crime pages.

description.pt_BR: Calor de 40 graus, biscoito Globo na areia e vista para o Pão de Açúcar. No Rio, até a rachadinha tem samba-enredo.
description.en: Forty-degree heat, Globo cookies on the sand and a view of Sugarloaf Mountain. In Rio, even the salary kickback scheme has its own carnival song.
